description:
All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution. 

 Description 
Join a mission‑driven team where you’ll design, build, and sustain modern applications and data‑driven solutions that accelerate automation, integration, and decision support across the enterprise.

 
 Design, develop, and deploy applications and services that integrate with Microsoft 365/Azure environments. 

 Lead development of Microsoft Power Platform solutions, especially Power Automate flows at scale (governance, monitoring, exception handling, connectors, ALM).

 Build intuitive Power BI reports/dashboards and data models that translate complex data into actionable insights.

 Integrate AI capabilities (prompt‑driven workflows, classification/extraction, copilots/assistants) into new and existing apps; bonus if you’ve used AskSage and Copilot in enterprise contexts.

 Partner with stakeholders to refine requirements, iterate quickly, and deliver secure, compliant solutions.

 Thrive in a hybrid team, remote day‑to‑day, Crystal City on‑site 1-3/week for sprint ceremonies, demos, and stakeholder sessions.

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 5+ years in software engineering with demonstrable delivery

 Advanced Power Automate expertise (HTTP actions, Graph/REST integration, custom connectors, solution packaging, environment strategies)

 Solid Power Platform knowledge and development experience (Power Apps basics, Power BI authoring, Dataverse/SharePoint as data sources)

 Proven experience building secure, production‑grade integrations

 Strong data skills: modeling, DAX/M, performance tuning, and governance in Power BI

 Excellent communication and stakeholder facilitation skills; comfort with rapid iteration and live demos

 CompTIA Security+ (or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire)

 One or more job related computing environment certifications (EX: Microsoft Power Platform certifications e.g., PL‑900/PL‑100/PL‑300) (or required within 6 months of hire)

 
  

 Clearance Required 

 
 Active or Current DoD Secret Clearance is required for this position 

 
  

 Desired Qualifications 

 
 Familiarity with AI in the Microsoft ecosystem (Copilot family, GenAI, Azure OpenAI, orchestration patterns); exposure to AskSage

 Experience in DoD/Army environments (e.g., Army 365), RMF/ATO awareness, or data handling in IL‑enclaves

 CI/CD for Power Platform (solutions, pipelines), test automation, and governance at scale

 Azure services: Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus, Storage

 Data engineering basics: Power Query, dataflows, incremental refresh, gateway configuration


 #LI-CW1 

 #DSA209 



 The posted salary range is a good-faith estimate. Actual compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. 
 

 DSA - Salary Pay Range
 $115,000 — $147,000 USD

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. DSA requires background checks , where permitted , by law. DSA is an E-Verify Employer.
